The disagreements were caused by API and parsing errors in the other models, not by actual security concerns.
disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by tool failures: the Qwen model encountered HTTP 400 errors when reviewing three files, and the Openrouter model failed to parse its own response. The Deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and correctly determined the package is safe.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO, firefox-nightly.desktop, and get_latest_version.sh due to HTTP 400 API errors.
Openrouter model failed to parse the LLM response for the PKGBUILD.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) to prevent partial audits from resulting in inconclusive verdicts.
Ensure the parsing logic for LLM responses is robust against slight formatting deviations to avoid parse failures.
